name: Dr. Alies Professional Beard Growth Oil | Natural Beard Care Oil for Patchy & Thin Beards | Moisturizing, Itch & Dandruff Care | 30ml
description:
Take better care of your beard and the skin underneath with Dr. Alies Professional Beard Growth Oil 30ml. Formulated with a blend of natural oils and herbal ingredients, this nourishing beard oil helps moisturize the skin, soften coarse beard hair, and support a healthier-looking, well-groomed beard. The lightweight, non-greasy formula is designed for daily beard care and is suitable for patchy, thin, coarse, and uneven beards. Regular use helps improve beard texture, manageability, softness, and shine while providing moisture to dry skin beneath the beard.

Key Features
Helps support thicker and fuller-looking beard growth
Nourishes beard hair and the skin underneath
Helps improve the appearance of patchy and uneven beards
Helps moisturize dry skin beneath the beard
Helps reduce beard dryness and itchiness
Helps minimize the appearance of beard dandruff caused by dryness
Softens coarse and rough beard hair
Helps improve beard texture, shine, and manageability
Lightweight and non-sticky formula

Suitable for daily beard care
Suitable for different beard types

How to Use
Clean and dry your beard before application
Apply a few drops of oil to your beard and the skin underneath
Gently massage with your fingertips, focusing on patchy or dry areas

Use regularly as part of your beard care routine

Other Ingredients as Listed on Product Packaging

For external use only
Avoid direct contact with eyes
